description: Elections Commission - Local Government Poll in Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha, amending Gaz. Ex. No. 2051/3
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the amendment of a polling date for a local authority election (Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
